instruction: What steps can I take to remove the cone icon from VLC's paused screen and show just a black screen?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
